title: Kusanagi Nene — Nervous Departure〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I didn't have much of an appetite during breakfast.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I guess I'm just that nervous about us working with a different troupe starting today...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (From what I've heard, the one we're visiting, Shunmeiza, doesn't really do musicals.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which means I can't sing my way out of this... Am I gonna be okay...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They're famous for emphasizing acting technique, and a lot of them have gone on to appear on TV and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(As nervous as I am...
I'm really excited about getting to see how they all practice.)
se_run_men_001_1
Morning, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh... Rui. Morning.
Wait, did you just run over here?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, after seeing you walking down the street. I thought we could head over together and—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Nothing. Just that you do look slightly pale.
I was wondering if you got enough sleep last night.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, I can't say that I did.
I'm actually feeling really nervous right now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But you don't need to worry about me. It's not like I'm sick or anything.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, okay. If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But I understand how you feel.
Shunmeiza is, after all, one of Japan's most famous theatre troupes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And we've somehow been invited to go learn from them...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: How do we even begin thanking Emu's brothers for this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I know what you mean. I plan on learning as much as I can since they're giving me a chance to talk to the directing and production teams.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, opportunities like this don't come around often...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm really nervous...
But I also wanna make the most of it by figuring out ways to grow...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-What is it now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was just thinking that you've changed so much, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I wouldn't have put it past the old you to say, “No, I can't do this! I'm going home...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know I've changed, but I doubt I would've actually said, “I'm going home!” after coming this far.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Rui, as far as I can remember, this sort of situation hasn't ever bothered you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, that's because the excitement of encountering the unknown overpowers any nerves.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But if I had to say...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Go on...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I felt very nervous when Tsukasa tested out that jump-assistance backpack since there was a small risk of him exiting the atmosphere...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I mean, what if my hand slipped and accidentally raised the setting too high?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I should've known. You started off looking all serious...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, you made another really dangerous contraption? What if it explodes or something...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, this one's different from the one that failed before. It's designed to give the user the ability to perform acrobatic stunts that are bound to stun the audience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I'd be stunned too if I saw someone exit the atmosphere...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, Emu just messaged the chat. What'd she say...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
<Nene, Rui, where are you guys?>
Wait, it's already time for us to meet!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. And Tsukasa's sent a barrage of stamps asking where we are.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As much as I was enjoying our stroll, Nene, we should hurry over.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Right...!
se_run_men_001_2
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I was so nervous just now...
But I feel a lot better now for some reason.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We hardly ever run together like this.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If only we had some high-speed running shoes we could put on, then we'd never be late...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, stop thinking about making another crazy contraption right now...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Argh!
Emu and Tsukasa keep sending stamps...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (There's always so much going on when I'm with the others that I never have time to feel nervous. But...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That actually helps me a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As we visit these troupes, we're probably gonna be faced with our fair share of challenges.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But we should do just fine as long as we all work together.)
